boundary: createCachedLoader wraps an asynchronous, read-only lookup keyed by the exact string supplied by the caller. Each wrapper instance owns independent state.
requirements: For a given key, overlapping requests share one unresolved origin lookup, regardless of how long that lookup takes.
Different keys must not share an origin lookup or a returned value.
A successful value is fresh for ttlMs logical milliseconds after it becomes available. A lookup at exactly the freshness deadline may start a new origin lookup.
Origin rejection rejects the waiting requests; a later request may retry.
clock: The injected now function returns a nondecreasing integer logical time. No real timers are required.
origin: An origin invocation is observable immediately when load(key) executes. A test-controlled gate can keep it unresolved. On gate release, return a fresh copy of the catalog entry for that exact key.
